name: shot-director
summary: Screenshots from the real game at set times after the level is ready, then quit: the way to see what a change looks like, and what a player's first frame looks like, without sitting at the machine.

MODULE.description: The C++ game module the two source files join (the directory under Source/).

adapt: Close the editor, then compile: node Tools/gam3/ue_build.mjs
Nothing to register: the subsystem creates itself when one of its flags is on the command line.

verified.how: Compiled into a fresh C++ project with ready-gate. ue_game.mjs --shots 0,5 --quit 10 --cam ... wrote both PNGs under the agent (640x360) and human (1920x1080) profiles and quit; the shot at 0 showed the complete level. The images were opened and checked. Shipping builds and Windows were not run. 0.2.1: a new shot is not requested while one is still being written, and the game does not quit while one is being written; four shots at 0, 0.5, 2 and 5 s at full quality on a heavy level wrote 4 of 4.
